whyUs.title: Why Choose Our Window Repair Company
whyUs.description: Slough sits between London and the Thames Valley, which means short trips to Windsor, Maidenhead and High Wycombe and straight runs into West London along the M4. Choosing a window repair company that covers both means one number to call for your home in Wembley and your rental flat in Slough.

process.title: How Our Window Repair Service Works
process.note: You know about the second visit up front. No one turns up expecting a one trip job that cannot be done.

areas.title: Areas We Cover: London, Slough and Berkshire
areas.description: We cover all of London and the towns along the M4 and M40.
areas.note: One team, based at 124 Oatlands Drive in Slough. We do not operate branch offices; every enquiry is handled centrally and the repair is carried out at your property.
